planner_plan.rationale: XR latency guarantees start with observation: KPM observe-ue reads UE/DRB-level KPM records to establish per-UE latency and throughput baselines for the active slice. Slice monitor then confirms UE-to-slice associations and reserved capacity without mutating policy, isolating whether the 5 ms breach stems from queueing rather than slice under-provisioning. TC apply-codel targets bufferbloat directly — CoDel bounds sojourn time in the downlink queues, the dominant contributor to XR latency spikes. RC rc-scaffold runs last as the policy gate, validating the applied control against fresh control opportunities and closing the loop. Risk: CoDel alone cannot fix latency caused by insufficient slice quota; if RC validation shows latency still above 5 ms, re-run with slice apply-static to enforce reserved capacity before shaping.
